description: Solar-grade c-Si cell process batch record (texture → emitter diffusion/PECVD passivation → metallization → flash IV test → power bin), emitted by the himawari cell_process cell (fed by ingot_wafer → waferBatchRecord; murakumo node benjamin). G3 (high-GWP NF₃/SF₆/CF₄ etch/clean gas ≥99% destruction-removal efficiency or substitution — never uncontrolled venting) + G6 (Ag→Cu low-toxicity metallization roadmap) + G1 (open process parameters) + G11 (deterministic-yield robot witness quorum; serial chain polysilicon → wafer → cell → module) structural enforcement. Materializes into the kotoba Datom log (EAVT); each property is one attribute keyed by the record CID, batchId roots the cell-batch entity. solar-grade c-Si only (N1) — NOT the iwakura/fuigo/tsukuru logic-grade EG-Si fab track. Per ADR-2606021200.

batchId.description: himawari-assigned cell-process batch identifier; one link in the polysilicon → wafer → cell → module serial chain (G11 traceability)

waferBatchId.description: upstream waferBatchRecord.batchId this cell batch was processed from (chains to com.etzhayyim.himawari.waferBatchRecord; G11 provenance back-link)

recordedAt.description: cell-batch attestation timestamp (ISO-8601); as-of point for the kotoba Datom history of this batch

cellArchitecture.description: cell device architecture; selects the texture/junction recipe and the gases tracked for the G3 gate

metallization.description: G6 Ag→Cu low-toxicity metallization roadmap; silver is permitted at R1 but off-roadmap (flagged), ag-cu-hybrid/copper are on-roadmap and required for R2+

waferCount.description: wafers entering the cell line for this batch (bin distribution sums to this)

gasAbatement.description: G3: per-gas destruction-removal-efficiency / substitution ledger for every fluorinated etch/clean gas used in this batch (the inline source for gasAbatementCid)

gasAbatementCid.description: G3: content-addressed NF₃/SF₆/CF₄/C₂F₆/C₃F₈ ≥99% abatement (DRE) or substitution attestation; pinned bundle of gasAbatement

binDistribution.description: power-bin split from flash IV; reject (binC) bin feeds the G5 kerf-recovery circular loop

binDistributionCid.description: content-addressed power-bin distribution bundle (the pinned form of binDistribution)

processParametersCid.description: G1: content-addressed open process parameters (texture / junction / metallization recipe) — published, not proprietary

flashIvMedianMilliwp.description: median cell power from AAA-class (IEC 60904-9) flash IV test (milliwatts-peak; integer to keep the EAVT attribute value exact)

flashIvCid.description: G11: content-addressed flash IV measurement bundle (per-bin Pmax/Voc/Isc/FF), Ed25519-witnessed by the Mimi metrology robot

metallizationFlags.description: G6 advisory flags (e.g. silver-only-off-roadmap); non-halting but logged for the Ag→Cu transition audit

anomalyFlags.description: constitutional-gate anomalies (e.g. G3 gas abatement below the 99% DRE floor); a non-empty list means the batch halted and escalated to a human PV-process engineer

attestingRobots.description: G11 robot witness quorum — DIDs of the ≥2 distinct robots (Otete cell-line executor + Mimi flash-IV metrology, COMPOSED from kuni-umi) that witnessed this batch. Mirrors the cell emitter's attestingRobots = [robotSignature.robotDid …]

robotSignatures.description: full Ed25519 witness bundle (robotDid + role + signature + timestamp) for the ≥2 attestingRobots; R2 pins real signatures over the record CID (G7-coupled robot-lineage accountability)

gasAbatement.description: G3 high-GWP fluorinated-gas abatement ledger for one cell batch. Every gas must be substituted away OR routed through abatement at ≥minDreFloor; uncontrolledVenting is never permitted (G3/N7 constitutional).

minDreFloor.description: G3 destruction-removal-efficiency floor in basis points 0-10000 (9900 = ≥99%); below this with no substitution halts the batch

gases.description: per-gas abatement line for every fluorinated etch/clean gas used this batch

uncontrolledVenting.description: G3/N7: must be false; true is a constitutional violation (uncontrolled venting of high-GWP gas is never permitted)

allMeetG3.description: true iff every gas line meets the G3 floor (substituted or DRE ≥ minDreFloor)

gasLine.description: One fluorinated gas in the G3 abatement ledger. GWP figures are AR5 100-yr values used industry-wide for the PV abatement gate.

substituted.description: true if this gas was substituted away (e.g. NF₃ → remote-F₂ clean); substitution satisfies G3 without abatement

substituteWith.description: substitute process/gas when substituted is true (omitted otherwise)

destructionRemovalEfficiencyBps.description: modeled/measured DRE in basis points 0-10000 (9950 = 99.5%); integer to keep the EAVT value exact

meetsG3Floor.description: true iff substituted OR destructionRemovalEfficiencyBps ≥ gasAbatement.minDreFloor

binDistribution.description: Power-bin split of a cell batch from the flash IV test. Counts sum to waferCount; the reject bin feeds the G5 kerf-recovery circular loop rather than waste.

binCReject.description: G5: broken / low-fill-factor reject count routed to the kerf-Si recovery loop (recovered, not landfilled)

robotSignature.description: G7-coupled Ed25519 robot witness attestation over the cell-batch bundle. Robot DID lineage logged so automated-away human QA tasks are accountable to the Liberation Metric (ADR-2605261000); robots COMPOSED from kuni-umi (Otete / Mimi).

robotDid.description: DID of the witnessing robot (e.g. did:web:etzhayyim.com:kuni-umi:otete / :mimi)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the attested cell-batch bundle (R2: real signature over the record CID)
